dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: After growing up, I will become a distinguished lady just like the priestess! I'll be smart, pretty, and strong!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Rana is pretty and strong, too. In all the stories I've read, it's always the pretty and strong people who live happily ever after...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: So, I must become strong just like Rana to marry her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Sorry, I can't tell you... But I have my reasons...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of two distinguished ladies...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Their story is interesting because the amazing queen and priestess are in it!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: It would be so sad if only one of them was in it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Bye! I'll grow up a bit more when we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #Whoa, it's {NICKNAME}. Are you here to play with me today?

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Oh, then go ahead, I have things to do, too!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #Whoa, it's {NICKNAME}. Are you here to play with me today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Rana said she was leaving for a trip. It looked like she would be away for a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: It does make me a little sad, but this is an opportunity for me to grow up while Rana's away!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Once I've grown up, I'll just show up in front of Rana and surprise her!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: No, I can't tell you... But I haven't seen them in a long time either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: Oh, then go ahead, I have things to do too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure Sudabeh will grow up to be a great distinguished lady!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {NICKNAME}! I'm learning really hard! To become a distinguished lady sooner, I'm learning how to cook!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, have a taste of the curry I made! My father and brother all thought it was good after they tried it!

dialogues.speaker: Sudabeh
dialogues.text: They told me not to cook this too often because it's worth being cherished since it's too delicious, but I will surely keep cooking it!
